cues.text: Thank you for joining me for this brief
tutorial focused on managing automated
liquid handler devices in the Arttowware
application. I have some great
information to share with you. So, let's
go ahead and get started.
There are a couple of different ways to
add an automated liquid handler device
within the ArtelWare application.
The first way is to click on the add
device shortcut from the get started
bar.
The second way is to click on the
configuration icon located to the far
left navigation panel and then select
the liquid handlers section. Let's
return to the home screen and use the
add device shortcut on the get started
bar.
Once I click on add device, I'm then
being prompted to determine what kind of
device I'm going to add. Today I'll be
adding a liquid handler and I'll click
okay.
Every time you see a field with a red
asterisk within our Telware, that means
that that field's required. The first
two fields that are required to add a
liquid handler are the manufacturer and
model. Let's go ahead and click on the
ellipsus.
Our Telware already has preloaded
several liquid handler manufacturers as
well as their most popular models.
If you don't see your liquid handler
manufacturer listed, it's okay. We can
easily add it by clicking on the plus
sign for add new ALH model to catalog.
I'm going to add a matrix wellmate and
I'll select add. And now you'll see the
matrix wellmate is listed as an
available option. I'll go ahead and
select okay.
And then I'll complete the rest of my
ALH information as well as the dispense
head. Today I'm going to be using a
Beckman Coulter FXP.
I'll go ahead and select okay.
And then from there I need to assign a
liquid handler ID.
Now some very important information
about this liquid handler ID field. The
ID itself cannot contain any spaces or
special characters. If you forget,
that's okay. The software will remind
you. In addition, the ID could be a
serial number that's attached to the
liquid handler itself,
or it could be an internal asset ID
number. Let's go ahead and enter our
internal asset ID number.
The description field is optional, so
we're going to go ahead and leave that
alone. And the serial number field is an
optional field as well. However, if your
liquid handler ID field doesn't contain
the robot's serial number within it, you
may very well want to add it in this
field. Let's go ahead and add the liquid
handler serial number itself. Next, we
need to add a location and an owner. The
ArtelWare software application will
default to the first location that's
listed in the location field. We're
going to go ahead and click on the
ellipsus and select Hawaii. Next, we'll
go ahead and click on the ellipsus for
the owner, and we'll select an owner for
this automated liquid handler. Now, you
might be tempted to select save from
here, but all that you've done is added
your robot.
Now, we need to add a dispense head for
that robot. We're going to click on the
dispense heads tab, and we'll click on
the plus sign.
You'll notice that I don't have any
dispense heads that are already
preloaded for the Beckman Coulter
device. To add a dispense head, simply
click on the plus sign to add new
dispense head. Now, the dispense head ID
could be an internal ID number or it
could be a serial number.
Enter your dispense head ID. The
manufacturer will remain as Beckman
Quilter. Select your number of channels
and enter the serial number for that
dispense head. And then if you want to
go ahead and enter an optional
description. So we'll go ahead and
select okay.
Now that I've added all of my dispense
heads, I'll go ahead and select save and
I'll save the entry.
So now you can see that I have one
Beckman Quilter FXP robot and two
dispense heads that are 96 channels each
that are available to test with that
robot.
Okay, that concludes our brief tutorial.
Do you have additional questions? Please
contact us at 1 800225434
option3 or at supporticmp.com.
Thank you.
